subject: SOC 2 exception: remediation plan, operational playbook & interim controls affirmation
messages:
From: Audit Team <audit@ledgerworks.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Findings summary + request for management response (SOC 2 control exception)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As mentioned, during our fieldwork we noted a control exception related to offboarding access reviews for a small set of service accounts (Control CC-5.2). We need a documented management response detailing:

- Root cause assessment
- Corrective actions already taken and planned remediation steps
- Expected closure timeline (target date)
- Interim compensating controls (if any) and how you will evidence them

Can you confirm whether Sparkline intends to accept an interim controls affirmation (signed) and provide a brief one-page executive summary for our report? Auditor leadership would also like an operational playbook or runbook that shows the new review flow (roles, frequency, evidence artifacts).

Please include any artifacts you can share (control owners, ticket references, remediation spreadsheet). We appreciate a preliminary response by EOD Friday, Nov 6, so we can draft the auditor commentary.

Best,
Rachel Lin
Senior Auditor, LedgerWorks

--
LedgerWorks Audit Services
attachment: findings_snapshot.pdf (summary, 45 KB)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.example>
To: Audit Team <audit@ledgerworks.com>, Sparkline Security <security@sparklinefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Findings summary + request for management response (SOC 2 control exception)

Rachel / Sparkline team,

Thank you for the clear summary and timeline. We take this exception seriously. Quick high-level response below; we will follow up with artifacts and a formal management response document and bridge letter draft within the timeline you requested.

Root cause (preliminary): an automated offboarding job failed to pick up recently created service accounts because the naming pattern changed during the orchestration refactor. This led to a 6-week window where those accounts were not flagged for review.

Immediate corrective actions taken (completed):
- Repaired offboarding job; re-ran discovery (completed 2026-11-05)
- Disabled 3 orphaned service accounts identified during re-run
- Created ticket INF-4521 to enforce naming standards and monitor job outcomes

Planned remediation (summary & target dates):
- Engineering patch to detection logic (in PR; target deploy 2026-11-09)
- Backfill review for prior 12 weeks (owner: Marissa Cole; target complete 2026-11-12)
- Update runbook and automate alerting on detection failures (owner: Karthik Iyer; target complete 2026-11-15)

Interim compensating controls we can provide immediately:
- Manual quarterly offboarding reconciliation worksheet (evidence: remediation_matrix_v1.xlsx)
- Weekly monitored job-status Slack channel with pinned alerts and escalations (logs retained)

We are amenable to signing an interim controls affirmation while remediation completes. I will coordinate the one-page executive summary and runbook artifacts; Marissa will lead evidence delivery.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Senior Manager, Compliance | Redwood Inference

Sofia / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying questions before we prepare the auditor commentary:

1) For the backfill reviews, will you be able to provide reviewer attestations (name, date, ticket link) as a single consolidated artifact?
2) Regarding the detection fix deployment: can you provide a short post-deploy verification checklist (pass/fail points) so we can see how you validated the change?
3) For the interim controls affirmation: auditor leadership prefers a named signatory with title. Can you confirm who will sign (CEO / Head of Security / Compliance lead) and whether DocuSign is acceptable?

Also, please confirm the audit period we should reference for our final report. We will note the exception in the Type II report that covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-31 unless you provide a reason to extend the audit window. If remediation completes before 2026-11-15, we can include management's closing evidence as post-period remediation; please indicate preference.

Best,
Rachel Lin
Senior Auditor, LedgerWorks

Hi Rachel / LedgerWorks / Sparkline team,

Appreciate the questions — below are our confirmations and the evidence delivery plan. We intend to close the exception as remediated with supporting evidence; however, because the exception was identified near the closing of your audit period we are also comfortable providing an interim controls affirmation signed by our Head of Security while you mark the finding as post-period remediation where appropriate.

1) Consolidated reviewer attestations:
- We will provide a single CSV export with reviewer name, date, and ticket link. Owner: Marissa Cole. Delivery: 2026-11-12

2) Post-deploy verification checklist:
- Checklist created and executed by Karthik Iyer; includes job run logs, smoke test pass criteria, and alert validation. Delivery: 2026-11-09 (post-deploy report attached link)

3) Interim controls affirmation signatory:
- Signatory: Priya Natarajan, Head of Security (Priya will sign via DocuSign). DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.example/docuSign/INT_AFFIRM_12345

Audit period confirmation:
- Please reference the Type II period as 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-31 for the report. We accept the exception being noted for that window. We will provide post-period remediation evidence (delivered by 2026-11-15) and ask that LedgerWorks include a short management addendum or bridge letter indicating remediation timeline and affirmation.

Next steps / deliverables:
- 2026-11-09: post-deploy verification checklist & deploy logs (Karthik)
- 2026-11-12: consolidated reviewer attestations CSV + reconciliation (Marissa)
- 2026-11-12: finalized bridge_letter_signed.pdf (Sofia to route to Priya for signature)
- 2026-11-15: updated runbook published and alerting enabled (Karthik)

If you need the one-page executive summary in a specific format, let me know and I will provide immediately. Otherwise, we will upload all artifacts to the Drive folder linked below and route the DocuSign for Priya tomorrow morning.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_spkl_playbook

Regards,
Sofia
